## D — Accuracy

Every fact block in parts C and C-two of this section cites exactly one physical page of the registered snapshot by anchor, and the statement is paraphrased from that page alone; the problem statement, the effects of alcohol, implied consent and administrative revocation resolve to the first selected page, and zero tolerance, refusal, the impairment thresholds, the container rules and other drugs to the second.

Confidence: high across the section; every threshold and rule is printed directly on its page. One source-form caution: on the first page the word crashes and two letters of the words alcohol and effect are set in separate text runs that interleave with the paragraph in the snapshot's text layer, so those sentences were reassembled in reading order. The decimal thresholds are spoken out in the statements exactly as printed, point zero two, point zero five and point zero eight.

Known source hazard: the manual's text layer carries a superseded hidden layer on some pages; every statement here was checked against the visible rendered page, not the hidden text, and no claim rests on hidden lines.

corpus_stability.reason: The Hawaii Driver's Manual is a periodically reprinted reference (imprint HMG 5/2023, copyright line through 2023); the the scale of the drinking-driver problem, how alcohol acts on the body, the implied consent and administrative revocation laws, zero tolerance for drivers under twenty-one, impairment thresholds, open container rules and the effects of prescription, over-the-counter and illegal drugs rules on pages 55–56 are statutory and procedural content that changes less than once a year, so no BlockedProbe.
